events.name: Open-source AI demo night
events.description:
​Open-source AI demo night with Cerebral Valley, AI Alliance, and Shack 15 @ the San Francisco Ferry Building!

​Join us for an open-source AI demo night presented in partnership with the AI Alliance. This event will convene developers and visionaries from across the Bay Area to showcase their work and the latest advancements across the AI ecosystem.

​​​Event schedule:

​5:00 PM - 5:20 PM Doors open & mingling

​5:20PM - 5:30PM Welcome remarks 

​5:30 PM - 6:20 PM Open Source Project Demos

​6:20 PM - 6:50 PM Safety in the era of open innovation in AI: a panel discussion

​6:50 PM ~ 7:00 PM Q&A

​7:00PM - 8:00PM Networking

​8:00PM Doors close

​​Want to demo your project? Please email hello@ollama.com for instructions! The project should use open-source AI for specific use cases (ie. agriculture, entertainment, code).

​​Thank you to co-hosts & sponsors at AI Alliance (https://thealliance.ai/) for making this happen!
events.descriptionSummary: An open-source AI demo night featuring developers and innovators showcased the latest advancements in AI, with a focus on projects across various sectors like agriculture and entertainment. The event included insightful discussions on safety in open AI innovation, highlighting the collaborative spirit fostered by prominent organizations like Cerebral Valley and AI Alliance.

events.name: Meta Llama Hackathon Brazil
events.description:
We’re excited to welcome you to the official Meta Llama Hackathon Brazil, hosted by Meta in collaboration with Cerebral Valley!

​​​This is a unique opportunity to bring together Brazil's growing AI community to build new AI applications using Meta's Llama models, alongside many of the best developers across Brazil's tech ecosystem. Meta's team will be in attendance, and hackers will receive hands-on support from the Meta team.

​​Winning teams will receive cash prizes as well as additional prizes to kickstart their Llama 3 projects. This event qualifies participants to submit their projects to the Llama Impact Grant program.

​Consider developing projects that address one of the following areas:

​Education & Culture - where you can use AI to improve learning outcomes and access to knowledge;

​Health - where you can improve healthcare services through accurate diagnosis and personalized treatments;

​Economic Development & Business Innovation - where you can use AI to generate value, improve efficiency, and scalability in businesses;

​Environment & Sustainability - where you can protect Brazil's biodiversity and promote sustainable practices

​Social issues - where you can use AI to positively impact access to public services, justice, and democracy.

​These topics offer a range of possibilities for innovative solutions that can make a positive impact on Brazilian society.

​​​We'd like to thank our sponsors for their contributions to this event:

​​​Groq (groq.com)

​Akash (akash.network)

​CodeGPT (codegpt.com)

​Itau (https://www.itau.com.br/)

​Cubo Itau (https://cubo.network/)

​​​Our speakers and judges will be some of the top names in the industry, and we will be announcing them soon... so stay tuned!

​​​Once approved, you will receive a series of Hackathon Guides to your email with additional information on judging, compute and projects. Approvals will be finalized ~10 days before the event begins.

​​​Please note: This is a fully in-person event - remote teams are not allowed. By registering you agree to Cerebral Valley TOS.
events.descriptionSummary: The Meta Llama Hackathon Brazil promises to unite the country's vibrant AI community, featuring hands-on support from Meta's experts and a chance to win cash prizes for innovative projects in education, health, economic development, sustainability, and social issues. With top industry names as speakers and judges, participants can look forward to an enriching experience that could lead to impactful solutions and eligibility for the Llama Impact Grant program.

events.name: Cerebral Valley National Security Hackathon

Hack on problems that matter – problem statements curated by US military stakeholders. Judges and mentors are from US government, startups, and venture capital firms. Full list of problem sets, judges, and mentors will be provided after registration.
Schedule:


Thursday, April 24th: Defense tech career fair at Stanford's campus hosted by Stanford DEFCON.

Friday, April 25th: Cocktails and team building at Stanford's campus.

Saturday, April 26th: 24 hours of hacking on problem sets begins in San Francisco, featuring speakers from commercial tech companies and government stakeholders.

Sunday, April 27th: Judging and prizes awarded!

Sponsored by: Shield Capital, IQT, NATO Innovation Fund, Vannevar Labs, Scale AI
Compute and inference from: Anthropic, Cerebras, and Microsoft
Data from: Maxar and Distributed Spectrum
Hardware from: Code Metal
events.descriptionSummary: The second annual US National Security Hackathon, hosted by Cerebral Valley and Shield Capital. Hack on problem statements with the who's who of defense tech and military stakeholders.
